text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as summer camp reached the 
halfway mark—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Hey~, C.B.! I ran over to the convenience 
store and got the jelly you asked for~.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you're awake again?! I told you 
to stay lying down.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I figured you'd be coming around now, 
Ace. I just woke up a bit ago and was 
doing some thinking.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Lost in thought...? That's rare for you. 
You got something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hm, the training camp's infirmary really 
has the exact same vibe as the academy's.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'd know! Even if they do look 
identical!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Good grief— If you've got time to think 
about stuff like that, go straight to 
sleep and kick that summer cold.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haha. Ace, you sound like a mom.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm not your mom!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
âCome on, just pick one already. I just 
bought whatever." thematically fits the 
context/"I just bought a random bunch."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll go with the mikan jelly. 
Which one do you want, Ace?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so the flow of things means I have to 
eat too...? Well, guess I'll go with 
peach, then.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~, that was delicious. Thanks, Ace. 
For going out of your way to buy it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, really. There was stuff I 
wanted to buy anyway.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...I just want your summer cold to get 
better soon.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu— I'll make sure it heals properly.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, those were so much fun. The 
Satsuki Sho and the Nippon Derby, that 
is."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how much fun the Kikuka-sho is 
going to be? I can hardly wait already.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, CB. Racing against me... is it 
actually fun for you?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh? Of course it's fun.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...I see. ...So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ace, you see— she really gives me a proper 
"race."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I guess that's the part that makes it fun.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Dedicate a race to you...? Well, 
obviously. What are you getting at?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Just as I said.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm gonna head to sleep soon. Thanks 
for today.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah. Well then, good night.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Nighty-night~.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(...CB's color looked completely back to 
normal.)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“Ace... You'll run a 'race' with me, 
right?”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"That's where the fun really begins, I 
think."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(What did that even mean in the end? I 
didn't really get it, but oh well—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Doesn't feel bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Anyway. If she's really looking forward 
to racing against me—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(All I gotta do is push past my limits and 
get way stronger this summer!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! I'll fire myself up for 
tomorrow too...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why, Trainer! I want to push 
myself even harder!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Please give me some hardcore extra 
training after this today! I feel like 
I've still got plenty more in me...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she'd already gone through a 
fairly grueling joint training session 
during the day, Katsuragi Ace's spirit was 
still overflowing with energy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems her motivation has skyrocketed 
even further. In that case, we have to 
make the most of it...!
choice_data_list:
Alright then, let's get started on the 
special extra menu!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! That's my Trainer, you really 
get it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The special extra training menu with 
Katsuragi Ace was—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
A demon...!? Does that mean the workload 
is insanely brutal!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Isn't that awesome...! Let's push 
those muscles to the absolute limit!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside a fiery Katsuragi Ace, 
we pushed our muscles relentlessly like 
demons...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Endless...!? So... it means infinity?!
choice_data_list:

limit!

text_block_list.text:
Sounds awesome! I super love running till

You push me to my limits without mercy

to forge my guts!

And so, alongside a fiery Katsuragi Ace,
